Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/tools?filters%5Bis_active%5D=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&for_mobile=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&include_configurable_generic_tools=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.summary: Add ERP Integrations project tool visibility gating in project tools responses
x-changelog.description: Project tools responses can now include an ERP Integrations tool entry. It is currently hidden from all users except Procore super users on ERP-integrated companies, and is not yet self-enableable by customers. No behavioral change is expected for existing customers.

x-changelog.summary: Add Studio Labs project tools availability in project tools responses
x-changelog.description: Project tools responses now include Studio Labs when it is available for the project context. This is a non-breaking enhancement to project tools payload visibility.

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"tools\":[{\"id\":1,\"is_active\":true,\"position\":3}]}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/tools", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
